source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC model option lackfit: ODS LackFitPartition
target_translation: sas_compat.hosmer_lemeshow(y, pd) -> partition frame. Inputs: the 105,000 training rows the fit used (none dropped: no missing model variable in model_features_train, batch-1 row 16), y = default_flag, p = the final model's pd (the pd_logistic written to risk_scores_train.csv). (1) sort by p ascending (stable). (2) BLOCKS: starting at the first unassigned row i, a block is every row with p <= p_i + 1e-6 (anchored at the block's SMALLEST pd, NOT chained between neighbours, NOT exact ties). (3) GROUPS (SAS LACKFIT partition, G = 10): M = floor(N/10 + 0.5) = 10500; the first block opens group 1; each next block of n_j rows joins the current group (current size c) if c < M and c + floor(n_j/2) <= M, else it opens a new group; finally, if the last group has <= floor(0.05*N) rows it is merged into the previous one. NGroups = number of groups (10 here). (4) every row's pd is replaced by its BLOCK'S SMALLEST pd for the expected counts: EventsExpected = sum of that pd over the group, NoneventsExpected = Total - EventsExpected; EventsObserved = count(default_flag = 1), NoneventsObserved = Total - EventsObserved. Columns in order Group (1..G), Total, EventsObserved, EventsExpected, NoneventsObserved, NoneventsExpected; integers plain, both Expected columns with 2 decimals ('85.82'). TODO(port): Totals depend on pd at the 1e-6 level, so a fully converged refit cannot match SAS's GCONV-stopped Totals exactly q: compare.py judges HL Total exactly (ABS_COL_TOL 0.0) but the RULEBOOK's converged fit (judge/fixtures/converged) moves 6 of 10 Totals by 1; widen Total to +-1 in the judge, or require the port to stop Fisher scoring where SAS does (GCONV=1e-8)?

source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC model option ctable: ODS Classification
target_translation: sas_compat.classification_table(X, y, pd) on the 105,000 training rows of the final model (X = intercept + the 18 selected variables, y = default_flag, pd = the final pd). (1) BIAS-ADJUSTED (one-step leave-one-out) probabilities: w = pd(1-pd); V = inverse(X' diag(w) X); q_j = x_j' V x_j; leverage h_j = w_j q_j; eta_j = logit(pd_j); pstar_j = 1/(1 + exp(-(eta_j - (y_j - pd_j) q_j / (1 - h_j)))). (2) GRID: ProbLevel from floor(min pd / 0.02)*0.02 to ceil(max pd / 0.02)*0.02 by 0.02 (0.000..0.880, 45 rows; pd min 0.00084, max 0.86250; pstar max 0.86374 gives the same grid, so pd vs pstar for the grid ends is untested). (3) at each level z a row is classified as an event when pstar >= z (> gives identical counts: no pstar on a grid point). n1 = events, n0 = nonevents: CorrectEvents = events classified event; CorrectNonevents = nonevents classified nonevent; IncorrectEvents = NONEVENTS classified event; IncorrectNonevents = EVENTS classified nonevent; Correct = 100*(CE+CN)/N; Sensitivity = 100*CE/n1; Specificity = 100*CN/n0; FalsePositive = 100*IE/(CE+IE); FalseNegative = 100*IN/(CN+IN); PPV = 100*CE/(CE+IE); NPV = 100*CN/(CN+IN); a 0 denominator gives missing -> EMPTY field (0.000 row: FalseNegative, NPV; 0.880 row: FalsePositive, PPV). Columns in that order (ProbLevel first). Printed: ProbLevel 3 decimals ('0.020'), counts integers, percentages 1 decimal ('93.5'). The listing shows only Pos/Neg Pred, the ODS dataset also has FalsePositive/FalseNegative = 100 - PPV/NPV

source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC model option ctable: ODS Classification
target_translation: sas_compat.classification_table(X, y, pd) on the 105,000 training rows of the final model (X = intercept + the 18 selected variables, y = default_flag, pd = the final pd). (1) BIAS-ADJUSTED (one-step leave-one-out) probabilities: w = pd(1-pd); V = inverse(X' diag(w) X); q_j = x_j' V x_j; leverage h_j = w_j q_j; eta_j = logit(pd_j); pstar_j = 1/(1 + exp(-(eta_j - (y_j - pd_j) q_j / (1 - h_j)))). (2) GRID: ProbLevel from floor(min pd / 0.02)*0.02 to ceil(max pd / 0.02)*0.02 by 0.02 (0.000..0.880, 45 rows; pd min 0.00084, max 0.86250; pstar max 0.86374 gives the same grid, so pd vs pstar for the grid ends is untested). (3) at each level z a row is classified as an event when pstar >= z (> gives identical counts: no pstar on a grid point). n1 = events, n0 = nonevents: CorrectEvents = events classified event; CorrectNonevents = nonevents classified nonevent; IncorrectEvents = NONEVENTS classified event; IncorrectNonevents = EVENTS classified nonevent; Correct = 100*(CE+CN)/N; Sensitivity = 100*CE/n1; Specificity = 100*CN/n0; FalsePositive = 100*IE/(CE+IE); FalseNegative = 100*IN/(CN+IN); PPV = 100*CE/(CE+IE); NPV = 100*CN/(CN+IN); a 0 denominator gives missing -> EMPTY field (0.000 row: FalseNegative, NPV; 0.880 row: FalsePositive, PPV). Columns in that order (ProbLevel first). Printed: ProbLevel 3 decimals ('0.020'), counts integers, percentages 1 decimal ('93.5'). The listing shows only Pos/Neg Pred, the ODS dataset also has FalsePositive/FalseNegative = 100 - PPV/NPV
